newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed in late trade.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade with most traders sidelined due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, dealers said on Monday.

"The market was quiet and featureless on lack of fresh factors. There's no fresh news but some people are waiting for Wednesday's issue of the (U.S. November) producer price index and Thursday's release of the (U.S. November) consumer price index data, for more clues to market direction," a local dealer said.
In day-to-day rates, Monday/Tuesday, Tuesday/Wednesday and week-fixed were unchanged from last Friday's common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from last Friday's 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 and twelve-months unchanged at 5-11/16 5-9/16 percent.
